## Make compare-estimand figures

Define functions:
```{r}
#' Extract data from statistical output tables
#'
#' @param outc_var 
#' @param Role 
#' @param tlf_reg optional metadata object
#'
#' @returns a structured `data.table` ready for plotting
#'
#' @examples
#' 
#' tlf_reg <- get_metadata()
#' d1 <- get_output_data(outc_var = "hamd_total17", tlf_reg = tlf_reg)
#' 
get_output_data <- function(outc_var = "madrs_total10", 
                            Role     = "Primary", 
                            tlf_reg  = NULL) {
  if(is.null(tlf_reg)) tlf_reg <- get_metadata()
  
  # Endpoint IDs for tables to extract from:
  tab <- tlf_reg[outcome_var == outc_var &
                   outcome_kind == "chgbl" &
                   role == Role &
                   tlf_type == "table", 
                 .(estimand, visit, endpoint_id, caption)]
  
  # Extract data:
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(tab)), function(i) { # i <- 1
    regi <- tlf_reg[endpoint_id == tab[i, endpoint_id]]
    res <- get_dt_table(regi)
    res <- res[Visit == paste("Day", tab[i, visit]) & 
                 grepl("[dD]exa", Treatment), 
               .(Treatment, estimate, lower.CL, upper.CL)]
    cbind(tab[i], res, regi[, .(outcome_label)])
  }) |> rbindlist()
}

#' Make plot to compare estimands 
#'
#' @param data the result of `get_output_data()`
#'
#' @returns a `ggplot2` plot.
#'
#' @examples
#' 
#' tlf_reg <- get_metadata()
#' d1 <- get_output_data(Chapter = "hamd_total17", tlf_reg = tlf_reg)
#' mk_estimand_compare_plot(d1)
#' 
mk_estimand_compare_plot <- function(data) {
  stopifnot(is.data.table(data) && nrow(data) >= 2L)
  
  # Check columns
  required_cols <- c("estimand", "visit", "endpoint_id", "Treatment", "estimate",
                     "lower.CL", "upper.CL", "outcome_label")
  test_required(required_cols, names(data), "data")
  .d <- data[, .SD, .SDcols = required_cols]

  .d[, Estimand := tools::toTitleCase(estimand)]
  .d[, Estimand := relevel(factor(Estimand), ref = "Policy")]
  .d[, n_visit2 := visit + fifelse(grepl("policy", estimand), .2, -.2)]
  .d[, visit_lab := as.character(round(visit))]
  if(any("MADRS~10~" %in% .d[, outcome_label]))
    .d[, visit_lab := fifelse(n_visit == 7, "7*", as.character(round(visit)))]

  xbreaks <- .d[, .SD[1, .(visit_lab)], by = visit]
  is_fake <- .d[, any(grepl("[fF]ake", Treatment))]
  yLab <- .d[1, parse(text = convert_subscript(outcome_label))] # to display MADRS~10~ ie. MADRS[10]
  
  
  p <- ggplot(.d, aes(n_visit2, estimate)) + 
    theme_classic() + 
    theme(legend.position = "right", legend.position.inside = c(0, 0)) + 
    
    # Lines and points:
    geom_line(aes(color = Estimand, linetype = Estimand)) + 
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Policy" = "solid", "Efficacy" = "longdash")) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Estimand, shape = Estimand)) + 
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, color = Estimand), 
                  width = 0.2) + 
    
    # Horizontal line at Y = 0:
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") + 
    
    # X and Y axes:
    scale_x_continuous("Days since Randomization", 
                       breaks = xbreaks[, visit], 
                       labels = xbreaks[, visit_lab],
                       minor_breaks = NULL, limits = c(3.5, 28.5)) + 
    scale_y_continuous(yLab) + 
    
    # Color palette:
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Efficacy" = "#009E73", "Policy" = "#CC79A7"))
  # scale_color_manual(values = c("#009E73", "#CC79A7"))
  
  # Add watermark if treatment labels are fake:
  if(is_fake) p <- p + 
    geom_text(x = 14, y = .d[, mean(estimate)], col = "red", 
              label = "Artificial pre-DBL\nTreatment Assignment", 
              size = 11, angle = 45, alpha = .2, check_overlap = TRUE)
  
  p
}
```


Determine which compare-estimand figures to make:

- We take all cases in metadata where `outcome_var` contains `compare estimands`
- We extract the right outcome variable names from the metadata `file_stem` field

```{r}
tlf_reg <- get_metadata()
cases <- tlf_reg[grepl("compare estimands", outcome_var), 
                 .(outcome_var, endpoint_id, folder, file_stem)]
cases[, outc_var := gsub("compare_estimands_", "", file_stem)]
stopifnot(all(cases[, outc_var] %in% tlf_reg[, unique(outcome_var)]))
cases
```

Generate and save all figures:
```{r}
for (i in seq_len(cases[, .N])) { # i <- 10
  d1 <- get_output_data(outc_var = cases[i, outc_var], tlf_reg = tlf_reg)

  # Add cross references to cache:  
  keys <- d1[, paste0(tools::toTitleCase(estimand), " at Day ", visit)]
  add_to_crossref(endpoint_id = cases[i, endpoint_id],
                  key         = keys,
                  source      = d1[, endpoint_id])
  
  # Make figure:
  fig <- mk_estimand_compare_plot(d1)

  # Make file paths:
  png_path <- cases[i, file.path(folder, paste0(file_stem, ".png"))]
  pdf_path <- cases[i, file.path(folder, paste0(file_stem, ".pdf"))]

  # Save figures:
  cowplot::ggsave2(filename = png_path, fig, width = 7, height = 4.3)
  cowplot::ggsave2(filename = pdf_path, fig, width = 7, height = 4.3)
}
```
